{{Top|leg}}
'''Uulshanti''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Uulshanti commented on the entry for the [[ENVC-370 Glove]], noting that the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] should not be counted on to stop more than a couple of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
